apparent: The samples look like a {n} Hz wave.
aliased: The signal is above half the sampling rate ({ny} Hz), so it shows up as a lower alias.
faithful: The signal is below half the sampling rate ({ny} Hz), so the samples keep its true frequency.
explore: Move the sliders and watch where the samples land.
goal: The signal is {f} Hz. Pick a sampling rate at which it shows up as a {target} Hz wave.
